questions.question: CrashLoopBackOff'ni qanday debug qilasiz?
questions.explanation: Container start bo'lib, darhol yiqilyapti va K8s restart'lar orasidagi kutishni oshiryapti. `kubectl logs --previous`, `describe pod` (exit code, Last State, events), config/secret/env, probe'lar, resurslarni tekshiring.

questions.question: ImagePullBackOff sabablari va yechimi?
questions.explanation: Node image'ni torta olmayapti: noto'g'ri nom/tag, private registry credential yo'q (`imagePullSecrets`), registry rate limit (Docker Hub), tarmoq/DNS, arxitektura mos emas (arm64 vs amd64).

questions.question: `kubectl exec`, `port-forward`, `debug` bilan pod ichini qanday tekshirasiz?
questions.explanation: exec — ishlayotgan container ichida buyruq; port-forward — pod/service portini lokalga ochish; `kubectl debug` — distroless image'da shell yo'q bo'lsa vaqtinchalik debug container qo'shish.

questions.question: Pod ichidan Service'ga ulanmayapti — DNS va network'ni qanday tekshirasiz?
questions.explanation: Service mavjudmi va selector pod label'lariga mosmi (`kubectl get endpoints`), pod ready'mi, DNS nom to'g'rimi (`svc.ns.svc.cluster.local`), port/targetPort, NetworkPolicy, CoreDNS sog'ligi.

questions.question: ServiceAccount nima va pod nega default token'ni olmasligi kerak?
questions.explanation: ServiceAccount — pod'ning K8s API (va IRSA orqali cloud) uchun identity'si. Default bo'yicha token pod'ga mount qilinadi; API kerak bo'lmagan pod uchun `automountServiceAccountToken: false` — pod buzilsa hujumchi API'dan foydalana olmaydi.

questions.question: `crictl` nima va node'da container'larni qachon u bilan tekshirasiz?
questions.explanation: `crictl` — CRI runtime (containerd, CRI-O) uchun CLI. K8s 1.24'dan dockershim yo'q, node'da `docker ps` ishlamasligi mumkin. Kubelet yoki API ishlamay qolganda node ichida pod/container/image holatini ko'rish uchun.

questions.question: Pod Security Standards: privileged, baseline, restricted va securityContext?
questions.explanation: PSS — uch daraja; Pod Security Admission namespace label'i orqali qo'llaydi. restricted: root emas, privilege escalation yo'q, capabilities drop ALL, seccomp RuntimeDefault, hostPath/hostNetwork yo'q.

questions.question: RBAC'ni least privilege bilan qanday loyihalaysiz va tekshirasiz?
questions.explanation: Namespace darajasida Role + RoleBinding, ClusterRole faqat zarur bo'lsa; aniq verb va resource (`*` yo'q); odamlar SSO guruhlari orqali; `kubectl auth can-i` bilan tekshirish. `secrets` list/get, `pods/exec`, `escalate`, `bind`, `impersonate` — xavfli huquqlar.

questions.question: NetworkPolicy bilan default-deny va kerakli trafikni ruxsat berish?
questions.explanation: Default'da hamma pod hammaga ulanadi. Namespace'da default-deny (ingress va egress) qo'yib, keyin aniq ruxsatlar: ingress-controller -> api, api -> db, hamma -> DNS (53). CNI qo'llab-quvvatlashi kerak (Calico, Cilium).

questions.question: Kubernetes Secret'larni xavfsiz boshqarish: External Secrets, Sealed Secrets, SOPS?
questions.explanation: K8s Secret faqat base64 — shifr emas. Himoya: etcd encryption at rest (KMS), RBAC, Git'da ochiq secret yo'q. Git'ga: Sealed Secrets/SOPS (shifrlangan); yoki External Secrets Operator — Vault/AWS Secrets Manager'dan sync.

questions.question: OOMKilled pod'ni qanday tahlil qilasiz?
questions.explanation: Container memory limitdan oshgan va kernel cgroup OOM killer o'ldirgan (exit 137). Haqiqiy foydalanish trendini ko'ring (leak yoki pik), limit to'g'rimi, runtime limitni biladimi (Go GOMEMLIMIT, JVM -XX:MaxRAMPercentage).

questions.question: Ingress/LoadBalancer orqali 502/503 — qayerdan qidirasiz?
questions.explanation: Zanjirni qatlamma-qatlam tekshiring: DNS -> LB (target health) -> Ingress controller loglari -> Service endpoints -> pod readiness/loglar. 503 ko'pincha endpoint yo'q; 502 — backend ulanishni uzdi (keepalive timeout nomuvofiqligi, pod o'chayotgan).

questions.question: Static pod nima va kubeadm cluster'da control plane qanday ishga tushadi?
questions.explanation: Static pod — kubelet to'g'ridan `/etc/kubernetes/manifests/` papkasidan o'qib ishga tushiradigan pod, apiserver'siz. kubeadm control plane komponentlarini (apiserver, etcd, scheduler, controller-manager) shunday ishga tushiradi; API'da 'mirror pod' sifatida ko'rinadi, lekin `kubectl delete` bilan o'chmaydi.

questions.question: Admission controller va webhook'lar (mutating/validating) nima?
questions.explanation: So'rov autentifikatsiya va RBAC'dan keyin, etcd'ga yozilishidan oldin admission bosqichidan o'tadi. Mutating webhook obyektni o'zgartiradi (sidecar inject, default qo'shish), validating — qabul qiladi yoki rad etadi (siyosat). Kyverno, Gatekeeper, Istio injector shunday ishlaydi.

questions.question: ownerReferences, garbage collection va finalizer'lar: nega namespace yoki pod 'Terminating'da osilib qoladi?
questions.explanation: ownerReferences obyektlarni bog'laydi (Deployment -> ReplicaSet -> Pod): egasi o'chsa, garbage collector bolalarini o'chiradi. Finalizer — o'chirishdan oldin bajarilishi kerak bo'lgan tozalash belgisi; controller uni olib tashlamaguncha obyekt Terminating'da qoladi.

questions.question: `dnsPolicy` va `hostNetwork`: pod DNS va tarmog'i qachon node'nikidan foydalanadi?
questions.explanation: `hostNetwork: true` — pod node'ning network namespace'ida (node IP va portlari): CNI agentlari, monitoring uchun. `dnsPolicy`: `ClusterFirst` (default, CoreDNS), `Default` (node'ning resolv.conf), `ClusterFirstWithHostNet` (hostNetwork pod ham cluster DNS ishlatsin), `None` + `dnsConfig`.

questions.question: Pod soatlab `Terminating` holatida qoldi. Sababi va xavfsiz yechim?
questions.explanation: Odatda finalizer tugamagan (PV detach, controller o'lgan) yoki node yo'q / kubelet javob bermayapti. Avval sabab: describe, finalizers, node holati. `--force --grace-period=0` oxirgi chora — StatefulSet'da ikki nusxa xavfi.

questions.question: Pod `Exit Code 143` bilan tugadi. 137 dan farqi?
questions.explanation: 143 = 128+15 — SIGTERM bilan to'xtatildi (odatda normal: deploy, scale down, liveness fail). 137 = 128+9 — SIGKILL: OOMKilled yoki grace period tugaganidan keyin majburan o'ldirilgan.

questions.question: cert-manager nima va Ingress uchun TLS sertifikatni qanday avtomatlashtiradi?
questions.explanation: cert-manager — K8s controller: Issuer/ClusterIssuer (Let's Encrypt, Vault, private CA) orqali sertifikat oladi, Secret'ga yozadi va muddati tugashidan oldin avtomatik yangilaydi. Ingress annotation bilan ishlaydi.

questions.question: `subPath` bilan mount qilingan ConfigMap yangilanmaydi. Nega?
questions.explanation: Oddiy ConfigMap volume symlink orqali avtomatik yangilanadi (~1 daqiqa). subPath bitta faylni bind-mount qiladi — symlink almashinuvini ko'rmaydi, yangilanish pod restart'gacha kelmaydi.

questions.question: `kubectl get events` nima ko'rsatadi va debug'da qanday ishlatiladi?
questions.explanation: Events — scheduler, kubelet, controller'larning qisqa muddatli xabarlari (FailedScheduling, BackOff, Unhealthy, FailedMount). Default ~1 soat saqlanadi, shuning uchun incident tarixi uchun eksport kerak.

questions.question: Supply chain xavfsizligi: image scanning, signing (cosign), admission policy?
questions.explanation: CI'da image scan (Trivy/Grype) va SBOM; image'ni cosign bilan imzolash (keyless, OIDC); cluster'da admission (Kyverno/Gatekeeper/sigstore policy-controller) faqat imzolangan, ishonchli registry'dan, digest bilan image'larni qabul qiladi.

questions.question: Multi-tenancy: bir cluster'da ko'p jamoani qanday izolyatsiya qilasiz?
questions.explanation: Soft multi-tenancy: namespace per team + RBAC + ResourceQuota/LimitRange + NetworkPolicy default-deny + PSS restricted + alohida node pool (taint) kerak bo'lsa. Hard (ishonchsiz tenant): alohida cluster yoki vCluster, sandbox runtime (gVisor/Kata).

questions.question: Kubernetes'da incident: 'hamma servislar sekin' — tizimli qanday tekshirasiz?
questions.explanation: Umumiy simptom = umumiy komponent: avval cluster darajasi (apiserver latency, CoreDNS, node'lar holati, CNI, ingress), keyin umumiy dependency (DB, cache), keyin o'zgarishlar (oxirgi deploy, upgrade, config). Metrika bilan gipotezalarni birma-bir yoping.

questions.question: Velero va cluster disaster recovery strategiyasi?
questions.explanation: DR = obyektlar (manifest) + persistent data. GitOps obyektlarni qayta yaratadi; Velero K8s obyektlari va PV snapshot'larini object storage'ga zaxiralaydi. DB uchun ilova darajasidagi backup (WAL/PITR). RTO/RPO bo'yicha muntazam tiklash mashqi.

questions.question: Kubernetes'da `ndots:5` nima va tashqi DNS so'rovlari nega sekin?
questions.explanation: Pod resolv.conf'ida ndots:5: nomda 5 tadan kam nuqta bo'lsa, avval search domain'lar (ns.svc.cluster.local, svc.cluster.local, …) sinab ko'riladi. `api.stripe.com` uchun 4-5 ta keraksiz so'rov — CoreDNS yuki va latency.
